description:
Browse and listen to 5,481 Osho audio discourses across 351 series in English and Hindi.

Download talks for offline listening. Save meaningful moments with timestamped bookmarks and notes. The app remembers your position so you can continue where you stopped.

Features:
- 351 discourse series covering Zen, Tantra, Tao, Sufism, Upanishads, Yoga, and more
- Offline listening and background downloads
- Background playback with Lock Screen, Control Center, AirPods and AirPlay controls
- Read-along transcripts with highlighted text, search and adjustable font size
- DeNoise controls for recording noise, volume boost and quiet speech
- Playback speed from 0.5x to 2x
- Bookmarks with timestamps, notes and categories
- Countdown and end-of-discourse sleep timers
- Recently played talks, listening history and daily listening statistics
- Progress, bookmarks and listening statistics synced through your own iCloud account
- Language filters, search and series sorting
- Downloaded audio accessible in the Files app
- Customizable accent colors and light, dark or system appearance

No app account is required. There are no ads or tracking. Every feature is free. Optional one-time tips through Apple help support development and unlock no features or content.

Osho Talks is an independent app and is not affiliated with OSHO International Foundation. Audio and transcripts are accessed from publicly available sources.
whatsNew:
- DeNoise brings noise reduction, volume boost and quiet-speech controls together in the player and Settings.
- Choose Best Quality, Balanced or Gentle Cleanup. First-use settings are Best Quality, Medium noise reduction, Medium boost and Gentle Lift.
- Improved noise reduction and playback reliability on older recordings.
- Open the transcript directly beside DeNoise in the player.
- Optional one-time tips are available under Settings > About > Support Development. All features remain free.
